overall_comment: Label every row operation: the unlabeled chains in 4(c) and 5(a) cost 2 points on arithmetic that was otherwise correct. In 1(c) and 6(a) you assert a result without the computation behind it, and a zero entry is not an argument for dependence. In 2(b), matrix multiplication is not commutative; vA is undefined because v has 1 column and A has 3 rows.
